description: Source code for an MD5 hashing driver utilizing hardware acceleration in the Linux kernel, part of the IFX UEIP project by Infineon Technologies. Implements initialization, update, finalization, and registration of MD5 hash functions.

methods.name: md5_transform
methods.description: Main interface to hardware-accelerated MD5 transformation, processes a 64-byte input block.

methods.name: md5_transform_helper
methods.description: Helper function to call md5_transform with current context.

methods.name: md5_update
methods.description: Updates MD5 hash with new data chunks.

methods.name: md5_final
methods.description: Finalizes MD5 hash computation and outputs the digest.

methods.name: ifxdeu_init_md5
methods.description: Registers the MD5 hash algorithm with the Linux crypto API.

methods.name: ifxdeu_fini_md5
methods.description: Unregisters the MD5 hash algorithm from the Linux crypto API.
